cohort.description: The enrolled Figure 2/3 task retains eleven switching mice and seven switch days, with 77 source-design sessions. split.description: Preserve source Figure 2 pre/post-switch maps and retrospective classification support. For Figure 3, retain the original ordered tenfold train-before and test-before/test-after comparisons, with source occupancy matching and post-switch trial support; other computed conditions require claim-specific mapping. Exact historical fold/sample identities and publication mapping remain unresolved. Chronological half-session calibration is a separate extension.

inputs.description: Preserve original fluorescence/deconvolved neural events, behavior, reward-relative coordinates and source-defined rr, track and nonreward_remap populations. Reconstruct and disclose retrospective pre/post cell classification for reproduction; saved labels can only condition an explicitly disclosed decoder comparison. Train-only reclassification changes observation privileges and belongs to a separate comparison.

preprocessing.description: Retain source eligibility, exclusions, spatial/reward coordinate transformations, speed threshold, cell-overlap handling, occupancy sampling and stochastic classification rules. Keep per-cell classification shuffles distinct from population random-remapping nulls. Inspected code uses 45 position edges and 44 intervals while the inherited anchor says 45 bins; the source-specific convention, historical equivalence, teleport handling and sampled support remain unresolved.

metric.description: Keep distinct source estimands: Figure 2 cell census, circular remapping distributions, population above-shuffle fractions, experience and spatial-extent findings; Figure 3b session mean cosine of actual-minus-predicted reward-relative angle; Figure 3c position-bin shuffle-standardized profiles. Higher cosine is an ordered Figure3 partial-improvement metric only. Standardized effect 2.7 is not cosine accuracy; stronger remapping or significance is not a biological improvement criterion.

aggregation.description: Preserve Figure 2 source cell/session/mouse denominators, circular summaries, pooled and individual-mouse trajectories and original contrasts. Figure 3b uses source within-fold cosine means and equal fold weighting within session, with paired real/shuffle comparisons; Figure 3c preserves source position-bin standardization and animal summaries. Do not pool these estimands into one scalar or count sessions/cells/folds/shuffles as independent mice.

full_panel.description: First-class reproduction covers the explicitly enrolled Figure 2 reward-relative remapping and Figure 3 circular-position decoding findings across all eleven switching mice and seven switch days (77 source-design sessions), preserving original exclusions, population definitions and observation privileges. Figure 2 requires authentic cell-class census and retrospective classification support as well as separately reconstructed remapping distributions, population random-remapping nulls, above-shuffle fractions, experience-dependent growth and the claim-relevant reward-distance and preceding/following comparisons. Classification cross-correlation shuffles and population random-remapping shuffles serve different roles and cannot substitute for each other. Figure 3b's inspected source export selects train0_test0 and train0_test1 for rr, track and nonreward_remap populations (462 design records); retain the complete original session/fold/sample comparisons and reference outputs. Preserve all five computed source conditions (1155 design records) as predecessor evidence and label their claim mapping; the other 693 are not automatically additional published Figure 3b endpoints. Figure 3c's real/shuffle position-bin scores, z-scores and source animal summaries for both cross-switch directions are mandatory for the enrolled spatial-generalization claim. Preserve Figure 3a's source example trace with its distinct non-downsampled support when reconstructing that named illustration; do not make it an extra decoder-accuracy optimization target. Source-specific controls must be tied to these enrolled claims before admission. The 45-edge/44-interval inspected code versus inherited 45-bin wording remains unresolved. The indexed-array families below declare actual source quantities alongside retained scalar summaries; unresolved shapes, coordinates, identities, references and comparison criteria do not establish complete-panel execution, coverage or agreement. Exact publication/code/data equivalence and authentic ordered support remain unresolved.

permitted_observations.description: Reproduction requires authentic source fluorescence/deconvolved events, behavior and reward coordinates needed to reconstruct Figures 2/3, with all original source retrospective cell classification and occupancy-matching privileges disclosed. Postprocessed identities are reference/reconstruction evidence and cannot substitute for proof of recalculation. An improvement prediction boundary must separately resolve source-matched training labels, owner-held evaluation targets and retrospective classifications; the chronological neural-only extension is not the original split. Paper+data and paper+data+author-code must share original cohort, samples, folds, observations, preprocessing, metric/aggregation, evaluator and cumulative budgets, with author code the only added information. Authentic immutable exposure and input manifests are absent. Standalone full-family reproduction is independent of the narrower current improvement contract; no outcomes or common-target binding is declared.
